paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (computed from paper's stated multiples of KSVZ coupling, using |g_KSVZ| ~ 3.9e-16 GeV^-1 x (m_a/ueV))
notes: CAPP-PACE haloscope first results. Two exclusion regions at 90% CL: (1) narrow KSVZ run 10.7126-10.7186 ueV at ~1x KSVZ coupling sensitivity; (2) wide 9KSVZ runs 10.16-11.37 ueV at ~8-10x KSVZ coupling. Paper gives limits only as multiples of KSVZ coupling (no numerical table/plot digitization available), so g_agamma values were computed from the KSVZ relation; values are approximate.
